bio.text: John Cornyn was first elected to the U.S. Senate in 2002 and was re-elected in 2008, 2014 and 2020.
He served as Senate Republican Whip from 2013 to 2019.
Before the Senate he was a Bexar County district judge from 1984, a Texas Supreme Court justice elected in 1990 and re-elected in 1996, and Texas Attorney General.
He was born in Houston and grew up in San Antonio, graduated from Trinity University in 1973 and St. Mary's Law School in 1977, and earned an LL.M. from the University of Virginia in 1995.
